parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Resolve forces, for example $R=12g\cos25^\circ+P\sin25^\circ$ and $P\cos25^\circ=F+12g\sin25^\circ$, or horizontally/vertically $P=F\cos25^\circ+R\sin25^\circ$ and $R\cos25^\circ=F\sin25^\circ+12g$ [M1 attempt resolving in any one direction; A1 any one correct equation; A1 any second correct equation]. $F=0.8R$ [M1 use of $F=\mu R$]. Complete method to find $P$ from two three-term equations [M1]. $P=242$ [A1]. Total 6.
